title: G7 complete preflight accepted mixed source checkpoints within one diagnostic case/group
evidence: Before repair, a valid complete G7 fixture with one row's source_checkpoint_id changed to a different nonempty identifier still returned formal_run_allowed_by_protocol=true with errors=[] under require_complete_plan=True. The seven arms therefore could silently refer to different source checkpoint lineage while sharing one G7 checkpoint ID.
remediation: Require one stable source_checkpoint_id for all seven diagnostic arms within each case_id/group_id, while allowing the documented source_run_id to remain distinct per diagnostic arm; add an adversarial source-checkpoint test and independently scan the immutable plan.
